project.name: Watch Later
project.description: Watch Later is a unified multi-platform application that automatically captures, categorizes, and organizes Instagram Reels into a personal knowledge library.

nodes.name: ReelSyncWorker.kt
nodes.summary: WorkManager worker handling offline queue sync, token refresh, and Reel upload to backend.

nodes.name: MainActivity.kt
nodes.summary: Main Android activity providing UI for authentication and settings with Jetpack Compose.

nodes.name: ShareCaptureActivity.kt
nodes.summary: Android activity handling ACTION_SEND share intents from Instagram/other apps silently.

nodes.name: worker.js
nodes.summary: Cloudflare Worker handling Reel submission, AI metadata extraction, Supabase sync, and Telegram alerts.

nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: Next.js root page rendering ServiceLandingPage and managing saved reels state.

nodes.name: ProductionLaunchVideo.tsx
nodes.summary: Interactive video showcase component featuring native H.264 video player and interactive playback.

nodes.name: ServiceLandingPage.tsx

nodes.name: SplashCursor.tsx

layers.name: Android Application

layers.name: Cloudflare Backend & Worker

layers.name: Web Dashboard & Landing Page

layers.name: Media & Creative Pipelines

layers.name: Configuration & Infrastructure

tour.title: Welcome to Watch Later
tour.description: Watch Later transforms scattered Instagram Reel saves into a unified, AI-categorized personal knowledge library. Let's tour the architecture across Android, Backend, and Web.

tour.title: Android Silent Share Capture
tour.description: ShareCaptureActivity intercepts incoming ACTION_SEND intents from Instagram with zero UI interruption, normalizing URLs via UrlHelper and enqueueing locally.

tour.title: Room Persistence & WorkManager Sync
tour.description: Saved reels are stored in Room database (LocalReel & ReelDao) and synced via ReelSyncWorker with exponential backoff and network monitoring.

tour.title: Cloudflare Serverless Edge Worker
tour.description: Backend worker ingests reel URLs, coordinates authentication with Supabase, triggers metadata extraction, and publishes real-time alerts.

tour.title: Kinetic Landing Page & Interactive Showcase
tour.description: ServiceLandingPage delivers a bespoke showcase with WebGL fluid cursor interaction (SplashCursor), interactive Reel dashboard preview, and native launch video playback.

tour.title: Swift Video Rendering Pipelines
tour.description: Native AVFoundation Swift scripts render 60fps cinematic launch videos with typography and scene motion directly from project assets.
